rationale: The message reports concrete probe results and observed command behaviors, delivering findings from testing rather than asking or proposing. It also contributes factual observations about multiple CLI outputs.

evidence.text: Probed outputs: sample a,b,c rows. count=3; headers => `1   a` etc, -j names only.
select 2,1 emits header/reordered. slice -s1 -e3 includes header then data rows 2,3; -i1 header+row2. reverse preserves header, reverses records.
flatten format `a   1` (3 spaces), each record separator `#`; -n labels 0-based indices; -c2 truncates UTF8 field to 2 + `...` (hello=>he...).
